items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Superior band and the McNally band worked for Huntsnagle, but he didn't, he didn't win with you, because he, he didn't, him, him and Louie Nelson, I was playing with Louie.

ctx.x: see, Eddie Grochet, Eddie Grochet and Huntsnagle, Eddie Grochet, we were at the ship. Yeah, two partners, see, Eddie Grochet, see, now, Manuel had his band on there, Joe had his band, see, well, because we used to work, we were the Superior band, see, when Superior band go, off on gigs, we work in there, we work, see, we'd always have three or four nights in the district.
